margin: Absolute axis transformation slope times0.25PDFpoint per extracted source point; sum point bounds for a derived linear contrast.
chronology: The extraction bound and source-value table were committed before guarded production began. The full analysis plan was recorded after production began but before inspection of new-production effect summaries. Earlier baseline diagnostics were known. Do not call this a fully preregistered analysis.
interpretation: A pre-production geometric extraction bound can support a declared descriptive comparison margin. It is neither original printed decimal precision, source Monte Carlo error, nor a scientific equivalence margin.
